also: he’s got what’s coming to him

terms.gloss: he’s got what was coming to him
terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase, “he has what was owed to him”; not found as a phrase in Lewis & Short or the Latinitas loci collections, so Traupman is the only evidence.

sources: Lewis & Short: debeo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 95, checked against the searchable text and the page images of the book.
